definitions.explanation: The act of handing something over from one party to another. Used for physical objects, documents, property, or responsibilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧です。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}います→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Package delivery will take place at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し{日|び}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まったら→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧、⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us once the property handover date is decided.

notes:
Compound noun formed from ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ ('to receive') and ⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ ('to hand over'). Describes the transaction of passing something from one party to another, emphasizing both the giving and receiving sides of the exchange.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し: key handover
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し: package delivery
- {受|う}け{渡|わた}し{日|び}: delivery date, handover date
- {受|う}け{渡|わた}し⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: handover location
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受|う}け{渡|わた}し: work handover (when changing positions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}し→引き渡し：30090_hikiwatashi⟧: delivery, surrender — often used in legal and real estate contexts; implies formal transfer of possession
- ⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧: delivery of goods — specifically for commercial deliveries
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}ぎ→引き継ぎ：08365_hikitsugi⟧: taking over, succession — focuses on continuing responsibilities rather than physical transfer
